cycles.method: Not measured. An event is one knob turn or YES on a DRUMMAP track: one 64-step map read (dm_generate) and an in-place rewrite of the track record (dm_write), on the UI task, never in an interrupt and never while the pattern plays. Each UI tick also reads a few bytes for the input layer. To measure on a unit: the base's development cost stamps around the knob, as VECTOR 0.3.0 measured a 64-step rewrite at 0.5 ms on the owner's MKII. Budget: one UI tick, 16.4 ms at 61 ticks a second, 4,330,000 cycles at 264 MHz.

load.method: Not measured. The module adds nothing to the frame interrupt (no render, no hook there) and has no MIDI path; its only work is the knob turn above.

stress.droppedExplanation: No flood ran: DRUMMAP sends and receives no MIDI; the stock sequencer plays the trigs it wrote. To run: DRUMMAP on eight tracks at 240 BPM for 60 s, turning controls on the current track and changing Part, checking that playback, the panel and USB stay up.
